name: Bug
flavor: Wherever there is A bug—there are MORE BUGS nearby.

tactics.easier: Focus fire on heroes with high armor or near heroes with strong AoE abilities.
tactics.harder: Multiple small creatures can fit in a single space. Surrounding a hero with 10–20 minions can get deadly FAST (especially if they have low armor or no AoE abilities)!

notes: Bug Minion summoned by other Swarming Bugs. Group trait Swarming Pheromones applies only to non-minion bugs, so omitted here. Section is part of the Giant Bugs chapter.

name: Giant Bug
flavor: Many giant bug species are able to eat anything and live anywhere—infesting caves, wildernesses, and even urban environs.

tactics.easier: Stay in melee reach or clump together with other bugs.
tactics.harder: Move out of melee reach after attacking; summon minions in places that block movement and obstruct heroes' plans.

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

name: Toughrider Bug
flavor: They possess a tough chitin coat and powerful jaws able to grip anything to the death, can fell entire forests if left unchecked.

tactics.easier: Focus fire on heroes with high armor or near heroes with strong AoE abilities.
tactics.harder: When Riding, attacks that miss you damage the Ridden target! Medium armor means these combo well with the Bonfire Bug's Eruption damage, taking no damage from it.

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

name: Acidshot Bug

traits.name: Acid Splash
traits.text: Melee attackers take 2 damage.

flavor: They possess caustic sacs of acid and the deft skill to fire them at long range. They also ooze it at anyone who ventures too close.

tactics.easier: Move adjacent to heroes and attack with disadvantage.
tactics.harder: Stay at range (e.g., trees, ceiling of a tunnel) shoot, then move further away.

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

name: Jacker Bug

traits.name: Hijacked
traits.text: (1/round) when able, you must Interpose for your Hijacker for free (healing ends).

flavor: When stung, every drop of blood in your body bends towards protecting your toxic captor until you die.

tactics.easier: Attack first, allowing heroes to easily Defend. Foreshadow the effects of the Toxin (via an NPC or Naturecraft checks).
tactics.harder: Attack with them last, after a hero has already Defended or attack in pairs to get damage through.

tactics.easier: Allow a hero who kills one to knock it in a direction where it will explode and take out other bugs.
tactics.harder: Skitter toward heroes who are clumped closely together, or start a chain reaction with other bonfire bugs!

traits.name: Lithify
traits.text: Max actions reduced by 1 (lasts for 10 min, can stack). Lithified 3 times: Petrified.

traits.name: Mighty Swarm

name: Mummy
flavor: Once a figure of prominence, their body preserved for an afterlife they never reached.

tactics.easier: Target high-defense or already Dazed heroes. If guarding a tomb, it will not pursue the heroes if they escape.
tactics.harder: Target Grappled heroes and ones not already Dazed.

notes: Header "lvl 6, undead"; no size printed.

name: Mummy Lord

traits.name: Cursed Gaze
traits.text: When crit: DC 20 INT save, or suffer 1 Wound.

actions.name: Infest
actions.text: Summon a Scarab Swarm with 2 HP. Then:

flavor: A king in life, now cursed in death. Still wears a symbol of its status from its former life.

tactics.easier: Your Scarab Swarms act next round, and attack heroes you aren't attacking.
tactics.harder: Your Scarab Swarms act immediately upon being summoned, focus Slam on Grappled heroes.

notes: Header "lvl 21, undead"; no size printed.

name: Audun, Desert's Maw

traits.name: Climb, Everyone!
traits.text: CLIMB!! Combat with Audun begins when it appears suddenly under the Heroes’ feet. On an Initiative roll of 20+ heroes begin combat 10 spaces away from Audun’s mouth; 10+, 8 spaces; less than that, 6 spaces. Moving away from Audun is Difficult Terrain.

traits.name: How to Harm Audun?
traits.text: Running straight toward its mouth is certainly an option (though likely an ill-advised one), but ranged attacks are a bit safer, and its Grappling tentacles can be attacked as normal.

traits.name: Eaten
traits.text: Restrained (escape DC 13), duffer X damage when Eaten and at the end of each of your turns. Gain advantage on all attacks against Audun.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: (Target the furthest non-Grappled enemy) 1d4+10. On hit, Grappled (escape DC 13 or any slashing or cold damage).

actions.name: Reel In & Devour
actions.text: (If half or more heroes are Grappled) Pull all Grappled creatures 2 spaces closer to its mouth. Any hero there is Eaten!

bloodied.text: At 90 HP, Sandquake. All heroes must make a DC 13 DEX save (with disadvantage if Grappled) or be pulled 4 spaces closer, 2 spaces instead on save.

lastStand.text: at 0 HP Audun is Dying! 60 more damage and it dies (spitting out any eaten heroes). Until then, it can choose TWICE on each of its turns.

notes: Header "lvl 6, large sudden pit of teeth" does not say solo; role set to solo because it uses the solo ACTIONS/BLOODIED/LAST STAND format. Eaten is a box below the block; "duffer X damage" printed as-is (placeholder X, likely "suffer"). No Speed printed (default 6 applied).

name: Sea Hag

traits.name: Blackwater Eye
traits.text: (1/round) when damaged, Frighten (DC 12 WIL).

traits.name: Drowning
traits.text: Silenced, suffer 1 Wound at the end of your turn while drowning (spend 2 actions retching to end).

bloodied.text: (25hp). Drown Ye! Heroes gain Drowning on a failed DC 12 STR save.

flavor: Hideous polluters of coves and bays, these hags ensnare passers-by with glints of treasure. They love to curse a sailor, then send them away to sink their ship.
notes: Header printed "lvl, 4". Drowning is a boxed condition definition. Tactics are placeholders ("xx"); omitted.

name: Green Hag

traits.name: Naughty Child!
traits.text: When Crit, ignore damage from exploding dice, deal that much damage back.

traits.name: Hobbled
traits.text: Half speed, ALL Reactions cost +1 action.

bloodied.text: (40 hp). Bitter Curse. Heroes are Hobbled on a failed DC 13 WIL save.

flavor: In swamps they wallow in secrets and schemes, practicing obscure and unknown magics. They are proud of their cunning and trick mortals into dooming themselves willingly.
notes: Header printed "lvl, 7". Hobbled is a boxed condition definition. Tactics are placeholders ("xx"); omitted.

name: Night Hag

traits.name: Gloam Step (1/Round)
traits.text: When damaged, teleport adjacent to an enemy, Frighten them.

traits.name: Terror
traits.text: Attack with disadvantage. On miss, damage self.

bloodied.text: (60 hp). Waking Nightmare. Heroes gain Terror on a failed DC 15 WIL save.

flavor: The cruelest of their kin. Their thirst for misery is so strong that they have toppled entire cities by turning every inhabitant against their neighbor.
notes: Header printed "lvl, 10". Block continues from the bottom of the first column to the top of the second. Terror is a boxed condition definition. Tactics are placeholders ("xx"); omitted.

name: Vesha, the Beauty

traits.name: Hagified
traits.text: (max 1 creature) Allies are frightened of you and require a WIL save to Help, Interpose, or Target. Any negative condition Vesha gains, is also applied to you.

traits.name: Made Beautiful
traits.text: Vesha also benefits from any beneficial spell or ability cast on an ally.

traits.name: Don’t look at me, I’m hideous!
traits.text: When Vesha is crit, end Hagified and Made Beautiful. Attacker makes a DC 14 WIL save or loses 1 action retching or gaping in horror.

actionsIntro: After each hero’s turn, move 3 then choose 1:

actions.name: Hag’s Curse
actions.text: (Reach 6) 1d8+10, on damage: Vesha is Made Beautiful and you are Hagified.

bloodied.text: At 110hp, select 1 hero to be Rotcursed: Whenever they take damage, deal 10 more.

lastStand.text: (80hp). At 0hp, Vesha is dying! 80 more damage and she dies! Until then ALL heroes are Rotcursed.

flavor: Depending on when and how you meet her, Vesha may appear a shriveled and hideous crone, or the fairest maiden in the land. This primordial hag drains the beauty from those whose appearances she covets, softening and de-aging her own features. But her efforts are ultimately futile. Her cruel and covetous nature corrupts any fair looks she attains, and within mere days she becomes uglier than before.
notes: Header "lvl 8, odious center of attention"; actions intro printed as "Solo. After each hero’s turn, move 3 then choose 1:". No size printed. Tactics are placeholders ("xx"); omitted.

name: Lizardfolk Reedstalker

traits.name: Sneak
traits.text: You are Invisible until you attack.

actions.name: Blowpipe
actions.text: (Range 8) 1d8, On damage: Poisoned for 1 round (healing ends).

flavor: Slight and agile, Reedstalkers patrol tribal borders and watch for intruders. They move unseen through trees and muck, striking from afar with blowpipes and poisoned darts.

tactics.easier: Attack already Poisoned heroes, act after Scalebreakers
tactics.harder: Attacks from Invisible can't be Defended or Interposed!

traits.name: Swift Defense
traits.text: (1/round) Can Interpose within Reach 4.

flavor: Broodguards are massive warriors chosen to protect the brood. They carry heavy snapping-turtle shells to defend their allies.

tactics.easier: Interpose against crits or other attacks good VS heavy armor. Hold position near other lizardfolk and forego attacking.
tactics.harder: Protect high-damage allies like Hunters. Interpose against attacks that are less effective against Heavy armor.

traits.name: Broodward

traits.name: Mother to us all

name: Swamp Raptor

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage when an ally is adjacent to target.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.text: 1d8+10. On crit: Prone & Restrained (Escape DC 10, or any damage to the Raptor).

flavor: Domesticated by the Lizardfolk, Swamp Raptors hunt, guard, and carry messages through the bogs. The fiercest defend hatcheries, attacking any without the tribe’s scent. When they die, their hides and bones are repurposed for tools and armor.

tactics.easier: Spread the Raptors and allies out, attacking different targets.
tactics.harder: Use their speed to attack isolated heroes in packs. They'll gain advantage from Pack Tactics, Prone, AND Restrained!

notes: Lizardfolk Special Abilities (Muck Walkers, Cold-Blooded) not applied to companions since they are not Lizardfolk.

name: Hydra

traits.name: Uh, guys…
traits.text: Starts with 2 heads. Gain 1 additional head at 120hp, 90hp, 60hp, and 30hp.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (Reach 3) 1d20 per head, you may split the damage dice among any creature in Reach. On damage, poisoned (healing ends).

flavor: Young hydras are captured and tamed through ritual using mist, drums, and pheromones. In peace, they are fed offerings—often trespassers. When one grows too large, the Lizardfolk deem it sacred, abandoning their village so the beast may rule the swamp.

tactics.easier: Spread the attacks out, or attack a Dying hero with all heads, it only counts as a single attack and is not likely to crit!
tactics.harder: Attack a single hero for devastating damage!

notes: No size printed. Lizardfolk Special Abilities not applied to companions.
